decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been subsequently agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - All new external finishes in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works to be carried out in this connection) shall match the existing building in respect of the materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance.

Condition : 4 - Appropriate measures, including the erection of protective fencing, shall be taken to protect the hedge alongside the boundary with 37 Chiswick Quay during  construction of the approved development.
description: Refurbishment and internal alterations to existing dwelling including new windows / doors, balconies to front and rear elevation and bay windows and rendering external facade of existing dwellinghouse
